relationships.subject: anastrozole
relationships.evidence_quote: Mice daily treated with anastrozole developed mechanical allodynia (from 2 h up to 6 h)

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraplantar Bk, DABk, or AITC enhanced and prolonged the mechanical allodynia (Figure 2C,F,I) and muscle strength loss (Figure 2D,G,J)

relationships.subject: icatibant
relationships.evidence_quote: Icatibant (100 nmol/kg, i.p.) (Supplementary Figure S1B) or DALBk (150 nmol/kg, i.p.) (Supplementary Figure S1D) reduced the anastrozole-induced mechanical allodynia from 0.5 up to 2 h after their administration

relationships.subject: DALBk
relationships.evidence_quote: Icatibant (100 nmol/kg, i.p.) (Supplementary Figure S1B) or DALBk (150 nmol/kg, i.p.) (Supplementary Figure S1D) reduced the anastrozole-induced mechanical allodynia from 0.5 up to 2 h after their administration

relationships.subject: A967079
relationships.evidence_quote: A967079 (100 mg/kg, p.o., 0.5 h prior) markedly prevented the sensitizing effect induced by Bk (Figure 4B) and DABk (Figure 4E) in anastrozole-treated animals

relationships.subject: B2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings suggest that PLC/PKC and PKA may act downstream from B2R and B1R activation to sensitize the TRPA1 channel, leading to painful anastrozole-induced symptoms.

relationships.subject: B1 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings suggest that PLC/PKC and PKA may act downstream from B2R and B1R activation to sensitize the TRPA1 channel, leading to painful anastrozole-induced symptoms.

key_findings: B2R and B1R activation sensitizes TRPA1 via PLC/PKC and PKA signaling in anastrozole-induced pain in mice.
